title: Q7: an optimum exactly at a boiling or dew point
body: At a bubble or dew point the flowsheet equations are singular by nature, so the ordinary certificate cannot verify an optimum that sits exactly there (measured: it happens on real cases).

The amended design checks such an optimum on a reduced form that removes exactly that one direction and flags the result as a phase-boundary optimum. The ordinary solve certificate stays unverified, and the record says which check passed.

options.label: Verify on the reduced form, with the flag
Report such optima as found but not verified
